name: 蔡佩珊
objective:
本課程將探討數位學習國內、外發展現況和不同領域進行分析包含數位學習新興趨勢，並就國內外發展狀況、我國現階段的推動及發展策略進行介紹。
The course is designed to examine future trends and research in e-learning. It will also explore the issues on the development of e -learning and practical issues.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
